other_exits: Stealth mode (Stelth=1): SL/TP are not sent to broker; instead positions are closed programmatically on tick when price movement in points reaches TP or -SL from open price. Labels drawn on chart at virtual SL/TP levels.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If last deal profit < 0, lot = last_deal_lot * KLot (martingale doubling). If lot exceeds MaxLot, reset to base Lot. If last deal profit >= 0, use base Lot.

custom_logic_notes: Alternating deal type gate: Buy only allowed if last deal was BUY or none; Sell only allowed if last deal was SELL or none. This creates an alternating entry pattern. Stealth SL/TP mode uses intrabar tick monitoring (lines 140-174) — positions are closed manually when unrealized P/L in points hits TP or -SL thresholds. The IsNewBar function has a bug: Print('New Bar!') is after return(true), so it never executes. The PutLable function has a bug: lines 190-194 (setting color, style, width) are after the return statement inside the if-block, so label properties are never set — labels are created but left with default appearance.
python_conversion_notes: Martingale lot sizing requires full deal history tracking. Stealth SL/TP mode requires tick-by-tick simulation to close positions at virtual stop levels — M1 or H1 backtesting would miss intrabar SL/TP hits. The LastDealType alternating gate must track the most recent closed deal type from history. The ADX filter uses buffer index 0 (main ADX line), not the +DI/-DI lines. BB entry uses previous bar values ([1] index with series set to true). Deviation (Slip=50) must be mapped to the Python broker's slippage model. CTrade wrapper in Trade.mqh handles order sending — direct Python equivalent needed with proper error handling and retry logic.
